why: a bare `a` in a block is neither a declaration nor a rule, so an engine drops it; the printer writes it back as authored (`NodeType.Raw`), escape included, as it does `*zoom: 1`
a statement opening no `{}` block is a parse error the spec drops, whether the input ends in it or a block's `;` or `}` ends it (§5.4.3); css-tree keeps it as raw text
